notes.C01: One signal drives demotion, caption skip and redundancy tag; cheap and testable against text-only QA.
notes.C02: Deletes the metered VLM, the biggest running cost, but staged and depends on retrieval quality.
notes.C03: Return map is useful for recurring footage, but layout switching adds a measured-ratio knob.
notes.C04: Medoid pick risks losing instance detail the embedder collapses; gated by tokens per correct answer.
notes.C05: Ask-conditioning with coverage floor is sound but overlaps proposal 3 find.
notes.C06: Cuts per-turn image tokens, the user's top cost, but is a policy flip more than a concept.
notes.C07: Closing the loop on the agent summary is a fresh, useful analysis step and doubles as a label-free bench score.
notes.C08: Three-modality agreement is tidy but speculative and needs the audio tower for modest gain.
notes.C09: Replaces hand knobs with per-video calibration, but calibration itself needs held-out cuts and can fail on short videos.
notes.C10: Narrow audio use with a pre-registered kill threshold; small value, loads a 300M tower.
notes.C11: Measurement ledger that makes every other idea provable cheaply; not novel but highest leverage.
notes.C12: Audit sheet and gap trace add honesty to output, but extra surface for a modest gain.
notes.C13: Sensible hygiene for deletions, mostly a documentation habit, little direct value.
notes.C14: Cheap, concrete MRL dimension sweep that shrinks storage; narrow value.
notes.C15: Meta scope-tracking rather than a use of the model; adds bench surface with no video understanding gain.
